import numpy as np

def cashflows(perf, terms):
    import numpy as np
    perf = np.asarray(perf)
    n_paths = perf.shape[0]
    n_dates = len(terms["observation_dates"])
    final_idx = int(terms["final_index"])
    notional = float(terms["notional"])

    cash = np.zeros((n_paths, n_dates), dtype=float)

    autocall = terms.get("autocall")
    coupon = terms.get("coupon")

    # track paths that have been called; initially none
    called = np.zeros(n_paths, dtype=bool)

    # Autocall handling (none for this note, kept generic for compliance)
    if autocall is not None:
        trigger = float(autocall["trigger"])
        call_amounts = autocall["call_amounts"]
        for k in range(n_dates):
            amt = call_amounts[k] if k < len(call_amounts) else None
            if amt is None:
                continue
            # performance on this observation date
            if perf.ndim == 3:
                if terms.get("n_assets", perf.shape[2]) == 1:
                    perf_k = perf[:, k, 0]
                else:
                    # worst-of for autocall
                    perf_k = np.min(perf[:, k, :], axis=1)
            else:
                perf_k = perf[:, k]
            # only not-yet-called paths can be called
            call_now = (~called) & (perf_k >= trigger)
            if np.any(call_now):
                cash[call_now, k] = float(amt)
                called[call_now] = True
        # coupon handling would need to respect called status
        # but coupon is None for this note

    # Maturity calculation for paths not called (all paths here)
    # Extract final performance
    if perf.ndim == 3:
        if terms.get("n_assets", 1) == 1:
            perf_final = perf[:, final_idx, 0]
        else:
            perf_final = np.min(perf[:, final_idx, :], axis=1)
    else:
        perf_final = perf[:, final_idx]

    upside = terms.get("upside")
    leverage = float(upside["leverage"]) if upside is not None and upside.get("leverage") is not None else 0.0
    cap = upside.get("cap") if upside is not None else None
    cap_val = float(cap) if cap is not None else np.inf

    # Filing: if ending > starting: 1000 + min(1000*return*150%, max_return=16.15%)
    # else: 1000 principal return at maturity regardless of performance
    underlier_return = perf_final - 1.0
    maturity = np.full(n_paths, notional, dtype=float)
    pos = underlier_return > 0
    if np.any(pos):
        lev_ret = leverage * underlier_return[pos]
        capped = np.minimum(lev_ret, cap_val)
        maturity[pos] = notional * (1.0 + capped)

    # Principal protection: even if below barrier/buffer, pay notional (filing overrides generic barrier)
    # Coupon handling (none for this note)
    if coupon is not None:
        # generic coupon logic respecting memory and barrier, for completeness
        barrier = float(coupon["barrier"])
        memory = bool(coupon.get("memory", False))
        amounts = coupon["amounts"]
        # count coupons due - simplified, only at dates where amount not None
        # This note has coupon None so not executed
        pass

    # assign maturity to uncalled paths at final index
    not_called = ~called
    cash[not_called, final_idx] = maturity[not_called]
    # called paths already have zero at maturity (initialized)

    return cash
